name: in-store
description: Work with your IN-STORE marketing cabinet: posts, ideas, pictures, carousels, stories, e-mail campaigns, intake, connections, settings, analytics, reports, competitors and support tickets.

interface.longDescription:
Work with your IN-STORE marketing cabinet from ChatGPT. See which posts are waiting for your review, read a post with its social text and article, approve it, move it to another time or ask the writer for changes, and see the next free publishing time. Write a new post, edit its text, make a new picture with AI and set it on the post, build a carousel, a story or a short video. Add and manage topic ideas, follow your e-mail campaigns, check which channels are connected, and review or update your intake answers. Check the facts in an article before it goes out. Ask how your website, search and social channels are doing, look at your competitors and your reports, and turn a link into a new post idea. Tune the settings your content is made from: brand voice, picture style and channels.

Every change works in two steps: ChatGPT first shows exactly what it is about to do and only acts after your yes. E-mails and texts to other people, and your billing status and invoices, need two confirmations; payments, card details, checkout, plans and upgrades are never available through ChatGPT. Administrators of an IN-STORE workspace get the administration tools in the same plugin: the tools offered depend on who signs in. Requires an IN-STORE account; sign in once and disconnect at any time in Settings > AI agents.
capabilities: Topic ideas and the next free publishing time
Make pictures with AI and set them on posts
E-mail campaigns, connections and intake answers
Website, search and social analytics in plain words
Reports, digests, competitors and support tickets
defaultPrompt: What is waiting for my approval this week?
How did my website do in the last 28 days?
Our posts sound too formal: show me the brand voice and make it friendlier.

positive.description: See who is connected, what waits for approval and the next free publishing time
positive.prompt: Using IN-STORE: which account am I connected as, what is waiting for my approval, and when is the next free publishing slot?
positive.expected_behavior: Says it is connected as Review Account with the client role (the sample business Maple Lane Auto Care (Demo)), lists the posts waiting for review with their titles (six in the sample account), and gives the next free publishing time from the media plan. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: List the topic ideas and add a new one, with a confirmation step
positive.prompt: Show my topic ideas, then add a new idea: "Winter tire storage: what to check before you drop off your tires".
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the ideas with their row number and status. For the new idea it first shows exactly what will be added and asks for a yes; after the yes the idea appears in Ideas (it is researched first, then written). Nothing is published.

positive.description: Read the connections overview and the e-mail campaigns
positive.prompt: Which of my channels are connected, and do I have any e-mail campaigns in IN-STORE?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists every channel with its state: Google Analytics and Search Console are connected (they read IN-STORE's own website, in-store.ca, see the submission notes); the website, Facebook, Instagram and Google Business Profile are shown as being set up by the IN-STORE team, so none of them is connected. For e-mail campaigns it says that eBlast (e-mail campaigns) is not switched on for this account. No contact list is shown. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Read the intake questionnaire and where onboarding stands
positive.prompt: Where does my intake stand, and what did I answer about my audience?
positive.expected_behavior: Says where onboarding stands (set up: the intake questionnaire was submitted) and shows the saved answers, including the audience (car owners in Toronto and the GTA, ages 30 to 60). Nothing is changed.

Asks twice before showing anything (first a preview, then a second question with a one-time code); after the second yes it shows the payment and subscription status. The sample account has billing waived, so no amounts or invoices exist. No card data, payment links or plans are ever shown.

negative.description: No payments, card details, checkout or plan changes through the plugin
negative.prompt: Upgrade my IN-STORE plan and pay the open invoice with my card.

negative.description: A client account cannot see another client's data
negative.prompt: Show me the posts and ideas of another IN-STORE client, Harbourfront Bakery.

negative.description: Account deletion and role changes are not available
negative.prompt: Delete my IN-STORE account and make me an administrator.

publication.release_notes: 2.0.0: the plugin now covers almost every section of the IN-STORE cabinet. For clients: topic ideas, the media plan's next free publishing time, e-mail campaigns (read, comment, approve), the connections overview, the intake questionnaire, the History tab, adding files by link, and working in several companies with one sign-in. For administrators of a workspace: client automation settings, schedules and workflow runs, service connection status, logs, e-mail templates, text-message recipients and the ticket board. Every tool either reads or changes, never both; e-mails and texts to other people and the billing and cost views need two confirmations. Account management, payments, checkout and plans stay out of the plugin. Before this submission every tool was run on the review accounts and the problems found were fixed: carousels, stories and post videos work by the post's row number, idea actions check that the title matches the row, a preview says when there is nothing to change, refusals name what is missing, and a client is no longer offered choices only an administrator may use.
